summary: Frontend-only regression testing of the tap-to-zoom image viewer on /products/brasso-velvet. Validated modal open/close, focus management, body scroll lock/restore, zoom in/out with disabled min/max states, reset, double-click toggle (100% <-> 210%), pointer drag panning, prev/next & modal thumbnail navigation resetting zoom, image counter, modal background opacity (rgba(10,25,47,0.95)), Escape close, underlying gallery still functional after close, and 390px mobile layout with no horizontal overflow. No console errors observed.

issues: Second product image appears to depict folded denim jeans rather than velvet fabric, which is inconsistent with the product name/description. Not caused by the zoom feature (pre-existing data), but visible in the zoom viewer. Recommend main agent verify /app/frontend/src/data/products.js image assets.

critical_code_review_comments: ProductImageViewer.jsx pan clamp uses a fixed 260px reference (line 11). This is independent of the actual rendered image size, so at higher zoom on very small viewports the pan range can exceed the visible image edge (empty gutter) or be too restrictive on very large screens. Consider deriving the clamp from the image's rendered bounding box.

onWheel calls event.preventDefault on a passive wheel listener; React attaches wheel handlers as passive by default, which will surface a console warning in some browsers. Use a native non-passive listener via useEffect if wheel zoom must block scroll.
keydown effect depends on `zoom` in the dependency array (line 61) causing the listener to be reattached on every zoom change. Minor perf concern; consider using a ref for current zoom.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Zoom range verified: min 100%, max 320%, step 40% via buttons, wheel step 25%, double-click default 210%. All zoom-related data-testids listed in the review request are present and functional. Backdrop click closes the modal only when the click target is the modal root element itself (header/footer areas do not dismiss — this is intentional per implementation). Escape closes and restores body overflow to previous value.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs found in the zoom viewer feature.
